name: 八字刘海锁骨内扣发
promptEn: Natural dark brown collarbone-length hair, center-parted curtain bangs opening into an inverted V and blending into cheek-framing side layers, smooth mostly straight lengths with subtle low layers and softly inward-curled ends, moderate natural volume and realistic individual strands.
promptZh: 自然深棕色锁骨发，中分八字刘海向两侧展开，与修饰脸颊的侧边层次自然衔接；主体顺直、低层次，发尾柔和内扣，发量适中，发丝质感真实自然。

name: 轻薄齐刘海齐颈波波头
promptEn: Natural black chin-to-upper-neck-length bob, wispy straight-across bangs grazing the eyebrows with small gaps between strands and slightly longer corners blending into cheek-framing side pieces, softly rounded crown and ears mostly covered, smooth mostly straight lengths with subtle low layers and gently inward-curved ends, a compact rounded silhouette with airy textured tips and realistic individual strands.
promptZh: 自然黑色齐颈波波头，长度在下巴至上颈部之间；轻薄齐刘海落在眉眼之间，发束间留有自然缝隙，两侧略长并衔接修饰脸颊的侧发；头顶柔和蓬松，基本遮住耳朵，主体顺直、低层次，发尾轻微内扣，轮廓圆润紧凑，发梢轻盈有纹理，发丝质感真实自然。

name: 微厚齐刘海齐颈波波头
promptEn: Natural black chin-to-upper-neck-length bob, moderately dense straight-across bangs grazing the eyebrows, softly covering the forehead with only a few narrow strand separations and lightly textured tips, slightly longer corners blending into cheek-framing side pieces, softly rounded crown and ears mostly covered, smooth mostly straight lengths with subtle low layers and gently inward-curved ends, a compact rounded silhouette with airy textured tips and realistic individual strands.
promptZh: 自然黑色齐颈波波头，长度在下巴至上颈部之间；齐刘海落在眉眼之间，厚度适中，较轻薄款略厚，柔和覆盖额头，仅保留少量细窄发束缝隙，末端自然轻盈；两侧略长并衔接修饰脸颊的侧发，头顶柔和蓬松，基本遮住耳朵，主体顺直、低层次，发尾轻微内扣，轮廓圆润紧凑，发梢轻盈有纹理，发丝质感真实自然。
